caption:
The average VantageScore 4.0 stayed at 701. 📊

VantageScore's September CreditGauge report (released Nov. 11) says average card utilization is the lowest since before the pandemic. Early-stage delinquencies were 1.15%, only 2 basis points above a year ago.

Steady, not dramatic. But your own file is what matters.

Do you know your utilization right now?
